hero.intro: *Fadime Mutlu.* I build end-to-end web solutions with React, Next.js and TypeScript, from admin panels and corporate websites to Apps Script automations and Node.js APIs.

about.label: About
about.title: A developer who turns designs into code and ideas into *products people use.*
paragraphs: I hold a B.Sc. in Computer Engineering from Necmettin Erbakan University and I'm currently pursuing my M.Sc. in the same field. I started my career as an intern engineer at Armiya Bilgi Teknolojileri during my final year.

For about three years I worked as a software developer at Konya Metropolitan Municipality's Kapsül Technology Platform. I built admin panels, corporate websites and automation portals that teams use every day, and took ownership of API integration, Git workflows and deployment alongside the interface.

experience.label: Experience
experience.title: Three years, *dozens of screens* and products running in production.

bullets: Built scalable, reusable component architectures with React.js, Next.js and TypeScript; designed responsive interfaces with Tailwind CSS.
Owned frontend development across several applications, including an admin panel, a mentor portal and the corporate website.
Built backend integrations with Google Apps Script and supported deployment steps such as builds and environment variables.
Developed dynamic web interfaces with HTML, CSS, Bootstrap and PHP, and built a WordPress-based website.
Designed interfaces with Figma and Photoshop; contributed to database management and to planning, testing and integration.

services.label: What I Do
services.title: A workflow that starts with the interface and *ends with the data.*

items.title: Interface
items.description: I turn a design into an interface that actually works in the browser. With React and Next.js I build components as reusable pieces, and TypeScript helps me catch mistakes while I write. Making a page feel equally polished on a phone and a wide screen is part of the job.

items.title: Admin panels
items.description: Dashboards, filterable tables, modal-based flows and permission matrices. I keep data flow and state management tidy so an admin can do their daily work from a single screen, quickly and without errors.

items.title: Automation
items.description: With Google Apps Script and Google Sheets I move manual processes online: reporting portals, PDF export, Drive integration, automatic email notifications and role-based access.

items.title: Services
items.description: With Node.js and Express I write the REST APIs the interface needs. Through validation, error handling and a modular router structure, I make sure the front and the back speak the same language.

featured.title: KTP Admin Panel
featured.description: A panel that manages all of Kapsül Technology Platform's content and workflows in one place. We turned static content such as events, announcements and quizzes into dynamic data.
highlights: Live stat cards and quick-action shortcuts
Google Forms-style dynamic form builder: conditional fields, consent, QR code, quiz mode
Permission matrix so every admin only sees the modules they're allowed to

featured.title: Kapsül Technology Platform Website
featured.description: The platform's corporate website, with Turkish/English content, light and dark themes, and dynamic pages fed by the admin panel.

featured.title: Mentor Pool System
featured.description: A system that digitises mentoring end to end: students create requests, mentors manage them and admins handle the matching.
highlights: Mentor sign-up, login and dashboard screens
Three-column (mentor–request–detail) admin view with live metrics
Monthly request quotas and automatic email notifications

featured.title: Corporate Automation Portals
featured.description: I designed and built five portals, used by different units of the organisation, end to end on Google Apps Script and Google Sheets.
highlights: Monthly Activity Report Portal: role-based access, meeting notes, PDF export
Overtime Tracking & OHS Risk Analysis portals
Community Support and Technical Trip application portals

faq.label: Questions
faq.title: Short answers to *what you might wonder.*

items.q: Which technologies do you work with?
items.a: Mostly React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. On the back end I build REST APIs with Node.js/Express and automations with Google Apps Script. I use Git and GitHub for version control.

items.q: What kinds of projects have you worked on?
items.a: Admin panels and dashboards, corporate websites, systems that run business processes such as mentoring and HR, and automation portals built on Google Sheets.
I start by understanding what the person using the screen needs to get done. Then I build components as reusable pieces, keep the data flow simple, and share work with my team regularly through Git.
Yes. I'm continuing my M.Sc. in Computer Engineering, and I'm currently deepening my back-end skills through the TNC Group Node.js training. The projects in the Lab section come from that.

items.q: Are you open to new opportunities?
items.a: Yes. For frontend-focused or full-stack roles and collaborations, you can reach me by email or on LinkedIn.
